Pocket Forest soundscape
All recordings are CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
The recordings are used as general ambience rather than calls of identified Tokushima species.

Bird — Curious Bird Chirp by qubodup
https://freesound.org/people/qubodup/sounds/812030/

Bee — Buzzing Insect Short.mp3 by FunWithSound
https://freesound.org/people/FunWithSound/sounds/390733/

Wind — Ambiance_Wind_Forest_Calm_Loop_Stereo.wav by Nox_Sound
https://freesound.org/people/Nox_Sound/sounds/506910/

Crickets — crickets.wav by Sclolex
https://freesound.org/people/Sclolex/sounds/210540/
